note: Provisional shape (schemaVersion 0). The Planner Engineer owns the schema and may rename fields in M1-01. `substitute` = the exercise whose GIF stands in when this one has none. `swap` = the exercise to do instead on pain or a kit problem. Callouts: 12 words or fewer, imperative, `commonMistake` phrased as the fix.

mediaSource.licence: See docs/spikes/s4-gifs.md. Personal, single-user use only.

callouts.setup: Lie on the bench, feet flat, shoulder blades squeezed together.
callouts.movement: Lower to chest level, then press up and slightly in.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep elbows at 45 degrees, not flared out wide.

callouts.setup: Set the bench one notch up, about 30 degrees.
callouts.movement: Lower to upper chest, then press straight up.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep your backside on the bench throughout.

callouts.setup: Hands under shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
callouts.movement: Lower your chest to a fist above the floor, push back.
callouts.commonMistake: Squeeze your bum so your hips stay level.

callouts.setup: Feet on the bench, hands under shoulders.
callouts.movement: Lower your chest towards the floor, then push back up.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep hips in line; do not pike upwards.

callouts.setup: Lie on the bench, dumbbells above chest, palms facing.
callouts.movement: Open arms wide in an arc, then hug them back.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep a soft bend in the elbows; stop at chest level.

callouts.setup: Sit upright, back on the bench, dumbbells at ear height.
callouts.movement: Press overhead until arms are straight, then lower slowly.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep ribs down and your back on the bench.

callouts.setup: Sit upright, dumbbells at chin height, palms facing you.
callouts.movement: Rotate palms forward as you press overhead.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep ribs down; press, do not lean back.

exercises.name: Lateral raise
exercises.usedIn: Upper A and B, all phases

callouts.setup: Stand tall, light dumbbells at your sides, slight elbow bend.
callouts.movement: Raise arms out to shoulder height, lower over two seconds.
callouts.commonMistake: Lead with elbows and keep shoulders down, away from ears.

exercises.name: Bent-over reverse fly
exercises.usedIn: Upper A and B, all phases

callouts.setup: Hinge forward, flat back, dumbbells hanging under shoulders.
callouts.movement: Raise arms out wide, squeezing shoulder blades together.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep your chest still; move only the arms.

callouts.setup: Stand, elbow tucked at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
callouts.movement: Rotate the forearm outwards, then back in slowly.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep the elbow pinned to your side; go light.

callouts.setup: Lie on the bench, dumbbells above chest, palms facing.
callouts.movement: Bend elbows to lower beside your head, then straighten.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep upper arms still and pointing at the ceiling.

callouts.setup: Sit upright, hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
callouts.movement: Lower it behind your head, then straighten your arms.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep elbows pointing forward and ribs down.

callouts.setup: Hands on the bench edge behind you, legs out.
callouts.movement: Bend elbows to lower your hips, then push back up.
callouts.commonMistake: Stop when upper arms are level; keep shoulders back.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.usedIn: Upper A and B once 3 × 5 negatives are done

callouts.setup: Hang from the bar, hands just wider than shoulders, palms away.
callouts.movement: Pull your chest towards the bar, then lower all the way.
callouts.commonMistake: Pull with your back, not by swinging your legs.

callouts.setup: Hang from the bar, hands shoulder-width, palms facing you.
callouts.movement: Pull your chin over the bar, then lower all the way.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep legs still; lower slowly, no dropping.

callouts.setup: Step up so your chin is over the bar, palms away.
callouts.movement: Lower yourself slowly over five seconds to a straight hang.
callouts.commonMistake: Fight the drop all the way down; count five.

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-up
exercises.usedIn: Library only: needs a band, which is not in the kit

callouts.setup: Loop the band over the bar, one foot or knee in it.
callouts.movement: Pull your chest towards the bar, then lower slowly.
callouts.commonMistake: Pull with your back; let the band only help.

callouts.setup: Hang from the bar with straight arms.
callouts.movement: Pull shoulders down and back to lift slightly, then relax.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep elbows straight; the shoulders do the work.

callouts.setup: One hand and knee on the bench, back flat.
callouts.movement: Pull the dumbbell to your hip, then lower to a stretch.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep your chest square to the floor; do not twist.

callouts.setup: Lie chest-down on the bench set to 30 degrees.
callouts.movement: Pull dumbbells to your ribs, squeezing shoulder blades together.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep your chest on the bench throughout.

callouts.setup: Lie on the bench, one dumbbell above chest, both hands.
callouts.movement: Lower it behind your head in an arc, then pull back.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep ribs down and elbows softly bent.

callouts.setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
callouts.movement: Curl up to shoulders, lower over two seconds.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep elbows by your sides; no swinging.

callouts.setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
callouts.movement: Curl up to shoulders, keeping palms facing in.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep elbows by your sides; lower slowly.

callouts.setup: Sit back on the bench set to 45 degrees, arms hanging.
callouts.movement: Curl up without moving your upper arms, lower slowly.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep shoulders back on the bench throughout.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.usedIn: Full body and warm-up, all phases

callouts.setup: Hold one dumbbell at your chest, feet shoulder-width.
callouts.movement: Sit down between your heels, then stand up tall.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep heels down and knees following your toes.

callouts.setup: Stand in a long stride, dumbbells at your sides.
callouts.movement: Lower the back knee towards the floor, then stand up.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep your front heel down and torso upright.

callouts.setup: Back foot on the bench, front foot a stride ahead.
callouts.movement: Lower the back knee towards the floor, then stand up.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep the front heel down; move straight up and down.

callouts.setup: Stand tall, dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees soft.
callouts.movement: Push hips back, slide dumbbells to mid-shin, then stand.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep your back flat and dumbbells close to your legs.

callouts.setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides.
callouts.movement: Step back, lower the back knee, then return to standing.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep your front knee over your toes, torso upright.

callouts.setup: Face the bench, dumbbells at your sides.
callouts.movement: Step up with one foot, stand tall, then step down slowly.
callouts.commonMistake: Push through the top foot; do not bounce off the floor.

callouts.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat near your bum.
callouts.movement: Push through heels to lift hips, squeeze, then lower.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep ribs down; lift with your bum, not your back.

media.providerName: glute bridge two legs on bench (male)

callouts.setup: Lie on your back, heels on the bench, knees bent.
callouts.movement: Push through heels to lift hips, squeeze, then lower.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep ribs down; stop when hips are level.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.usedIn: Full body from week 4, all phases

callouts.setup: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, feet hip-width.
callouts.movement: Rise onto your toes, pause, lower over two seconds.
callouts.commonMistake: Go all the way up and down; no bouncing.

callouts.setup: Stand on one foot, dumbbell in that hand, wall for balance.
callouts.movement: Rise onto your toes, pause, lower over two seconds.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep the knee straight; no bouncing at the bottom.

callouts.setup: Forearms under shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
callouts.movement: Hold still and breathe steadily.
callouts.commonMistake: Squeeze your bum and keep ribs down.

callouts.setup: Lie on your side, elbow under shoulder, legs stacked.
callouts.movement: Lift hips into a straight line and hold.
callouts.commonMistake: Push hips forward so you are not folding.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.usedIn: Core block and indoor circuit, Phase 1

callouts.setup: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent over hips.
callouts.movement: Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly, then swap.
callouts.commonMistake: Press your lower back into the floor throughout.

callouts.setup: Lie on your back, arms overhead, legs straight.
callouts.movement: Lift shoulders and legs a little off the floor, hold.
callouts.commonMistake: Press your lower back into the floor; bend knees if needed.

callouts.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent over hips, hands down.
callouts.movement: Curl hips off the floor towards your chest, lower slowly.
callouts.commonMistake: Use your stomach, not momentum; move slowly.

callouts.setup: Hang from the bar, shoulders pulled down.
callouts.movement: Raise knees to your chest, then lower slowly.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep still; no swinging between reps.

callouts.setup: Hang from the bar, shoulders pulled down, legs straight.
callouts.movement: Raise straight legs to hip height, then lower slowly.
callouts.commonMistake: Curl your hips up; no swinging.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.usedIn: Full body and indoor circuit, all phases

callouts.setup: Pick up heavy dumbbells, stand tall, shoulders back.
callouts.movement: Walk with short, steady steps for the time.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep shoulders level and ribs down; no leaning.

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.usedIn: Warm-up and indoor circuit, every session

callouts.setup: Step into a long lunge, hands on the floor.
callouts.movement: Drop the elbow to the instep, then rotate that arm up.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep the back knee off the floor; move slowly.

callouts.setup: Start in a push-up position, arms straight.
callouts.movement: Let your chest sink between shoulders, then push it away.
callouts.commonMistake: Keep elbows straight; only the shoulder blades move.
